verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an Issue Status / states-and-triage page, Ownership Rules for assigning owners, and a bulk-mutate API for changing issue state. Its MCP server and CLI also advertise issue triage and issue management. However, the evidence consists mostly of page titles, and none of it explicitly describes ignore/snooze options or automatic reopening of resolved issues on regression. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of ignore/snooze (archive) behavior, documented automatic regression detection that reopens resolved issues, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the triage workflow.
